title: LiteX (enjoy-digital/litex) -- the simulation SoC around VexRiscv
_note: Migen emits one flat Verilog module per SoC: `sim` is the litex_sim SoC (CPU
wrapper, wishbone / CSR interconnect, UART, timer, SRAM / ROM with their
--no-compile` at release 2026.08; the CPU comes from the pythondata-cpu-vexriscv
package litex_setup clones next to litex (VexRiscv.v, the GenFull-like
configuration LiteX ships).  litex_setup --init clones the LiteX ecosystem
(migen, litedram, liteeth, ...) into the generate cwd and --install adds them
to the user site; --tag pins every repository to the release.
